Commentary.Commentary: The total will test New Zealand's batting. Bangladesh have a good bowling unit and if they bowl in right areas, they can cause trouble. Promises to be an exciting chase. Do join us in a short while.

Ish Sodhi and Mitchell Santner bowled exceptionally well to put brakes on the scoring rate in the middle overs. They mounted pressure on the opposition batsmen which resulted in wickets. Hamish Bennett also impressed one and all with his express pace and ended with three wickets.

Mushfiqur Rahim and Mahmudullah played handy knocks in the middle order, while Mosaddek Hossain also added quick runs to the total. However, the fall of continuous wickets didn't let Bangladesh finish on a high.

Bangladesh have crawled their way to 257! A challenging total on a pitch which seems to be offering good assistance to the bowlers. The Asian team started well after put into bat under overcast conditions. Their openers added 72 runs upfront. Soumya Sarkar, in particular, looked in sublime touch as he cracked a wonderful half century. New Zealand bounced back after that and kept picking wickets at regular intervals.
Angles it away from the batsman, Rahman swishes and misses. The keeper fumbles and they cross for a bye. BANGLADESH END ON 257/9!

OUT! Mortaza is run out! A short delivery angling into the batsman, Mashrafe pulls it to deep mid-wicket and attempts the second run. The throw comes to the keeper who takes the bails off. They appeal, it's referred upstairs. The replays show that the Bangladeshi skipper has not planted his bat.
A shortish length outside off, another swing and a miss by the Bangladeshi skipper.
Rubel Hossain is the new batsman.
Follows the batsman down the leg side with a fine bouncer, Mortaza ducks as it goes past his gloves.
OUT! Bennett digs in a short ball, well-directed, Mehedi goes for the pull shot but fails to time it properly. A safe catch taken at fine leg, once again Seth Rance is the fielder.
Slips a length ball down the leg side, Mashrafe swings and misses. His partner calls him through for a quick run. Two wides!
Mashrafe Mortaza is the new batsman.

OUT! Straight to the fielder! Length delivery outside off, slower in pace, Mosaddek gets across the stumps to play a fine paddle scoop but ends up handing a straightforward catch to Rance at short fine leg. He makes no mistake.
FOUR! Another full toss, this time the bowler isn't getting away with it. Mehedi makes room by going down the leg side and whacks it to the sweeper cover boundary.
Misses the yorker again and serves a full toss outside off, Mosaddek shuffles across the stumps and heaves it over mid-wicket for a single.
Another slower delivery, a low full toss on off, it's hit towards covers for one.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.
A low full toss on off, Mehedi gets across the stumps and paddles it to short fine leg. Bennett stationed there dives to his right to make a good stop. They take a single.
A dipping yorker on middle, Mosaddek forces it past the bowler to mid off for a single.
Gives the charge and tries to pull but once again fails to middle it. Fine over, 4 runs and a wicket from it!
Sharp short delivery angling into the batsman, Mehedi tries to pull but is beaten for pace.
Short on middle, looked more like a mistimed pull shot through square leg for a run.
Sliding down the leg side again, once again Mosaddek fails to flick and it goes off his pads to Ronchi.
Wide! An attempted slower delivery going down the leg side, Hossain tries to flick but misses.
Mehedi Hasan is the new batsman.

OUT! Mahmudullah is bounced out! The extra pace of Hamish Bennett does the trick. He bangs it in short, Mahmudullah takes the challenge to pull it over the leg side but the bounce gets big on him and he ends up top edging it in the air. Seth Rance circles underneath it from backward square leg and completes the catch near the short fine leg region. Well taken, never took his eyes off the ball. Another timely breakthrough for New Zealand.
Wide! Slips a full ball down the leg side, Mahmudullah fails to get any wood behind it.
Short in length outside off, Mosaddek tries to cut but under edges it behind. The keeper runs forward to collect it and they pinch a single in the meantime.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full toss on off, Mahmudullah swings it over mid-wicket and it lands safely in the deep. A single taken.
Knocks a full ball down to long on for a run.
17th ODI fifty for Mahmudullah!

Fine half century by Mahmudullah, at a good strike rate and he has kept Bangladesh going in this innings in spite of losing partners. Back of a length delivery, slower in pace, Mahmudullah mistimes his pull to mid-wicket for a run.

Keeps it full and on off, Mahmudullah makes space and drills it through covers. The fielder in the deep, Colin Munro slips while making the stop and lands awkwardly on his hips. He is in some pain and the physio comes out. A couple of runs taken.
Yorker, hitting the blockhole, Mahmudullah digs it out back to the bowler.
FOUR! Full ball on leg stump. Hossain moves away and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Gives himself room, Neesham bowls it full on leg stump and it is hit down the ground for a single.
FOUR! Dances down the track, Neesham bowls it on a length and it is hit over covers for a boundary.
WIDE! Short and high above the head of the batsman and it is signaled wide by the umpire.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off and it is guided down past short third for a boundary.
Short and slower ball, wide outside off and it is cut straight to point.
Full ball outside off, Mahmudullah drives it through point for a couple.
Full ball on off, it is driven to mid off for a single.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.
Full ball, Hossain gets an inside edge to short fine for a single.
FOUR! Cut away, short and wide outside off, Hossain rocks back and cuts it through point for a boundary.

Run out appeal! A yorker on off, Hossain keeps it out on the off side and his partner wants a run. He is sent back and there is a direct hit at the bowler's end. They appeal and the umpire goes upstairs. Mahmudullah is easily in, shows the replay.
Seth Rance comes in to bowl.
Slower short ball and it is pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Great stop there by the Broom. Short outside off and the batsman cuts it but can't get it past point who dives to his right and saves a certain boundary.
Driven through mid off by the batsman.
Slower ball on off stump, it is guided down to third man by the batsman for a run.
Hits the length, Mahmudullah defends it off the back foot.
Short on middle and it is pulled to square leg for a run.
Bennet comes into the attack.
Quicker and it is driven to mid-off for a single. Santner is bowled out now. Fine spell by him, 10-1-37-1!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. They pick up a single.
Backs away gives himself room and lofts the loopy delivery over covers and they run through for the third.
Tossed up on off, Hossain  drives it  through covers for a couple of runs.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flat on a length and it is defended towards covers for a single. 200 up for Bangladesh.
On the pads and it is tickled down to fine leg for a run.
FOUR! Poor fielding there at point. Short outside off it is cut through point for a boundary.
Short ball on middle and it is pulled over mid-wicket, they run back for the third.
Short ball outside off, it is creamed to deep point for a run.
On a length on middle stump, Mahmudullah defends it of the back foot.
Full tailing back in, Mahmudullah tries to drive it but gets an inside edge straight back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. A maiden over by Santner.
Floats it up and it is driven straight back to the bowler.
Flighted on off and it is driven to mid-off.
Short outside off and it is cut straight to point.
Flighted on off and it is driven to covers.
Flat ball on middle, it is defended back to the bowler by Hossain.
Powerplay 3 time! 5 players are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle for the last ten overs.
Good length outside off, Hossain guides it down to third man for a run.
Back of a length on middle, the batsman defends the ball off the back foot.
Short ball on the body off Mahmudulla, he rock bakc and pulls it with power but straight to deep square leg.
Fractionally short around off, Mahmudullah pushes at it and misses.
Works it off his pads to deep square leg for one.
Outside off, left alone.
Flat on middle, gets a little spin and is defended of the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flat on middle and Mahmudullah defends it onto the ground.
Flighted on middle, gets a little turn and it is defended off the front foot.
Short on off and the batsman cuts it thorugh poin for a single.
Flighted on a length and it is defended off the front foot.
Mitchell Santner is brought back into the attack.
FOUR! A freebie by Neesham. Short and wide outside off, Mahmudullah has all the time in the world to put it away to the deep point boundary.
Good length ball, it is defended by covering the line of the ball.
Full ball on off stump and it is pushed to covers.
Good length outside off and the batsman guides it down to third man for a run.
Hits a length on off stump and it is defended off the back foot to point
Mosaddek Hossain is the new batsman.

OUT! Gone, New Zealand keep chipping away at the wickets. This one is a big setback for Bangladesh as a set batsman is out of here. Neesham bowls it on a length around the off stump, nipping away a little. Rahim opens the face of the bat and tries to guide it down to third man. But he only manages to find an outside edge and Luke Ronchi takes a good diving catch to his right. Outstanding!
FOUR! Shot! A half-tracker on middle, Mahmudullah goes deep inside the crease and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
Again tosses it up and it is flat-batted by Rahim to mid on. Dot ball.
Short ball and is cut through point for a run.
FOUR! Loopy ball on middle stump, Mahmudullah sits down on one knee and lofts it straight back past the bowler for a boundary.
Flighted ball on off stump, the batsman guides it to short third for no run.
Fractionally short and around off, defended from the back foot.
FOUR! Poor fielding! Short in length and outside off, Rahim rocks back and whacks it through cover-point. The fielder in the deep makes a sloppy effort and allows it through to the fence.

Shout for a catch! Full and angling down the leg side, Rahim tries to flick but misses. There is some noise when it goes past the batsman and they appeal. But nothing from the umpire. No signal for a wide either. So maybe the sound was of the ball brushing the pads.
Wide! Going down the leg side, the batsman fails to flick.
Short again outside off, cut through point for one.
24th ODI fifty for Mushfiqur Rahim! Shortish and outside off, Rahim cuts it through point for a single. Fine knock by Rahim. He has kept one end tightly!
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Loopy ball on off stump and Mahmudullah drives it past covers for a run.
Flighted ball on the stumps and it is defended onto the ground.
Short again, Rahim cuts it past the diving point fielder for a run.
Short on off stump, Rahim cuts it straight to point for no run.
Flat and short, Mahmudullah rocks back and pushes it down the ground for a run.
Loopy ball on off stump, Mahmudullah drives it to covers for no runs.

Drinks break. New Zealand have enjoyed a good phase of play where they managed to pick a few wickets. Their spinners have done a commendable job to pull things back. The last recognized Bangladesh pair is out at the moment and one more wicket will expose the tail. The Kiwis will be eyeing that.
Gets forward and pushes it to covers for a single.
Shortish outside off, punched through covers for one.
The batsman works it down the leg side. No run.
FOUR! Santner pitches the ball half way down on the middle stump and Rahim pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Easy pickings for Rahim.
Flighted ball on leg stump, Rahim flicks it away for a single.
Flat on a length, the batsman tries to defend it off the front foot, gets an inside edge and gets through for a single as the ball rolls to short fine leg.
FOUR! Short again, outside the off stump, the batsman rocks back and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Flighted ball, played to the mid-wicket region for no run.
Quicker ball on off stump and the batsman goes onto the back foot and punches it through the off side for  a single.
Loopy ball and the batsman comes down the wicket and lofts it over mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Short on middle and Mahmudullah rocks back and pulls it over short mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short outside off by Sodhi, it is cut through point for a run.
Flat and quick on middle stump and is defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Tossed up on off stump. Rahim drives through covers for a run.
Loopy ball on off stump and Rahim defends it by coming on the front foot.
Flighted, the batsman takes it on the full and drives it past cover for a run.
Slightly short on off stump and it is defended off the back foot.
Short ball on off stump and it is played to point for a single.
Mitchell Santner comes back into the attack.
Very full and the batsman digs it out.
Quicker ball and it is played to the point region.
Loopy ball on leg stump, Rahim flicks it for a single to square leg.
Flatter and a tad short, Mahmudullah goes onto the back foot and tucks it on the leg side for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle and the batsman defends it of the front foot.
Flighted ball on off stump, the batsman comes forward and defends it.
Gets on the front foot and pushes it to covers where the fielder misfields and they take a run. Sloppy.
Short outside off, width on offer, Mahmudullah taps it down to short third man.
Full length ball nipping back into the batsman, Mahmudullah fails to defend it off his front foot and is hit on the pads. A stifled appeal but it's missing leg.
An off cutter landing around off, Mahmudullah gets forward to defend but it catches the inside edge and speeds through square leg. They take a couple of runs.
Straighter in line, it's tucked nicely off the hips through square leg for one.
Full and angling into the batsman, Rahim pushes it from the crease to covers.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Mahmudullah cuts it from the back foot to point.
Mahmudullah is the new batsman. A slip in place, New Zealand sensing a chance here.

OUT! Excellent catch! Dot balls built pressure and Shakib has thrown his wicket away. A loopy full ball around middle, Shakib tries to loft it over mid off but fails to get any timing behind the shot. It's dying in front of Neesham inside the ring who does well to get down low to take the catch. Bangladesh losing plot.
Drags his length short on middle, Shakib immediately gets back to pull but once again Taylor stands at backward square leg like a rock and stops it with a dive.
Flatter and fuller on leg, swept on the leg side but Taylor stopped it with a dive at backward square leg.
Floated leg spinner on middle, Shakib tries to flick but misses. Is hit high on the pads.
In the air... safe! Full and on middle, Shakib hits it back hard, it's uppish but just wide of the left outstretched hand of the bowler. A single taken towards mid on.

FOUR! Brilliant shot! Short of a length ball on off, Shakib rises on his back foot, rides the bounce and whacks it square of the wicket on the off side. The sweeper cover tries his best to cut it off but fails in his attempt.
Full and on middle, Shakib lunges and defends it back.
Very full and on leg, flicked on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
FOUR! A streaky one! Full and outside off, Rahim tries to stroke his drive through covers but edges it towards short third man. Sloppy effort by Sodhi stationed there and it's a boundary.
Colin Munro is introduced into the attack.
Turns it off his pads to the leg side but finds backward square leg. Excellent over, just one run from it!
Lunges to a full ball and blocks it to covers.
Tries flicking on the leg side but gets a big outside edge. It rolls straight to short third man.
Loopy and on middle, it's played with the spin to backward square leg.
A nicely flighted ball around leg, Shakib tries to flick but misses.
A mistimed slog through mid-wicket for a single.
Short delivery outside off, cut behind point for one.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Serves it on a length outside off, Rahim pushes it to mid off.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Gets back and turns it on the leg side for a single.
Goes back to a short ball and cuts it through point for a run.
Shakib Al Hasan comes out to bat.

OUT! Sarkar departs! Big breakthrough for New Zealand. Sodhi is pumped up. He serves a loopy full ball around off, Soumya tries to slog sweep but gets it away off the top edge. It balloons in the air, Latham moves across to his left at square leg and completes the catch safely. End of a fine knock by Sarkar.
Kneels and sweeps it against the spin through the gap on the leg side for one at deep square leg.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Rahim punches it from the crease to mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Goes down on one knee for the slog sweep but gets it away off the inside edge to fine leg.
Digs in a short ball in the line of the stumps, Sarkar tries to play the ramp shot but fails to connect and falls in the process as well.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Short on the body of Sarkar, he pulls it down to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length on leg stump and the batsman flicks it to square leg for a single.
Good length on off stump, the batsman tries to defend it but gets an edge through the vacant slip area and they run for a couple of runs.
Bowled on a length on the pads of the batsman, he tucks it to square leg for a single.
Floated full ball on middle, drifting in a bit, Rahim lunges and defends it solidly.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
Fails to flick it on the leg side and it goes off his pads to short fine leg.
Another short ball on middle, pulled with the turn to fine leg for one.
Half-tracker on middle, pulled to deep backward square leg for a run.
Tossed up ball on middle, Rahim goes down on one knee and sweeps it in front of square leg. The fielder in the deep rushes across to his left to make a sliding stop. Saves two for his side.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
Short and pulled to deep square leg for a run.
Digs in a short ball on middle, Sarkar ramps it down to third man and the fielder in the deep stops it on one bounce.
Back of a length ball on off, Rahim jumps and dabs it to third man for a run.
Beaten! Back of a length ball outside off, holding its line, Rahim has a tame push inside the line and misses.
Hamish Bennett is brought back into the attack.
A low full toss on middle, Sarkar helps it straight to short mid-wicket.
Jumps out of the crease and plays it with the spin to short mid-wicket. The fielder quickly gets to the ball and Soumya returns to the crease.
Flatter and shorter on off, Rahim punches it down to long on for one.

FOUR! Loopy full ball on middle, Rahim gets down on one knee and sweeps it firmly through square leg. Worker near the ropes tries to pull it back but his body was in touch with the ropes. The onfield umpire gets it confirmed from upstairs and signals a boundary. The third umpire watched numerous replays before reaching to that decision.
Gets forward and pushes it with the spin to cover-point.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot.
FOUR! Uppish but safe! Rance lands it on a length outside off, Sarkar drives it on the up past the extra cover fielder for a boundary.
Rahim opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Wide! Way wide outside off, movement takes it further away as Rahim leaves.
SIX! Rahim attacks the length delivery by Rance by advancing down the track. He makes space for his bat swing and powers it over long off for a biggie.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
Movement back into the batsman from a length outside off, Rahim tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Goes down on one knee and sweeps it through square leg for one.
Probably a top spinner, some extra bounce, Rahim defends it by going back.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated ball on off, defended back off the front foot.
Walks down the track to take it on the full and heaves it over mid-wicket for one.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Ish Sodhi to bowl his leggies.
A nice looking drive by Rahim but straight to mid off.
Appeal for an lbw, not given. Rahim gets forward to defend but misses as the ball cuts back in to ping him on the front pad. Too high probably.
Slight movement away from the batsman, Rahim shoulders arms.
Presses forward and defends it back.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Helps it off his pads to deep backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Seth Rance is brought back into the attack.
Short and wide outside off, Sarkar tries to cut but misses.
Turns it off his pads to short fine leg for a run.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new batsman.

Drinks break. New Zealand have pulled things back in the last few overs by bagging a couple of wickets. Soumya Sarkar, however, is still there, batting on 51 and he would hope to build partnerships with the batsmen to come.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Excellent delivery by Santner. He hurls in a well-disguised arm ball, around off, Rahman gets back to play for the spin which is not there. He just stands there watching the ball skidding past his bat and breaking the stumps. Failed to pick the variations and paid a big price for it. Good phase of play for the Kiwis.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Skidding away from the batsman, Sarkar gets it away from the outside edge past the keeper. A single taken.
5th ODI fifty for Soumya Sarkar!
Fifty for Sarkar! A good knock by the opener. Width on offer outside off, Sarkar runs it down to third man for one.
Neesham persists with the shorter ball and this time forces an error from the batsman. However, it's of no use. Sarkar top edges his attempted pull over the keeper for a couple.
Short and angling into the batsman from around off, Sarkar swivels and pulls it to long leg for a brace.
Angling down the leg side, nudged to long leg for one.
Sabbir Rahman is the new batsman at number 3.

OUT! New Zealand finally taste success. Neesham serves a short delivery outside off Tamim slaps it  through the line and it goes over covers. Falls straight down the throat of Colin Munro in the deep. Tamim will be really disappointed to get out in this way.
Wide! Slower one going down the leg side this time, Tamim fails to work it away.
Width on offer outside off, Sarkar throws his bat at it and edges it down to third man for one.
Wide! A wild deliver by Neesham, it's too wide outside off to bother the batsman.
A tad short and around off, spinning in, Tamim goes back and defends it safely. Tidy over by Mitchell Santner!
Turns it wide of square leg for a run.
Walks down to the pitch of the deliver and plays it with the spin to short mid-wicket.
Gets down on one knee with the sweep shot but finds the square leg fielder.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Attempts to run it down but finds the short third man fielder.

FIVE RUNS! Neesham delivers a full ball on middle, Sarkar nudges it to mid-wicket and crosses for a run. Taylor misses his shy at the bowler's end and with no one backing it up, the ball goes for a boundary. Bonus runs for Bangladesh.
Full outside off, the batsman drives at it but misses the ball and it goes through to the keeper.
Hits the length and Sarkar defends the ball by covering the line of it.
Cracking shot but just for a single. Length ball and Tamim cracks it through covers but straight to the man at deep covers for a run.
Short of a length ball, takes a leading edge and goes down to third man for a run.
On a length and the batsman gets beaten.
FOUR! Santner sends across a short delivery around off, it skids away with the angle and Tamim plays a late cut just wide of the keeper for a boundary.
Quicker and the batsman defends it off the front foot.
Santner gives it some air and the batsman defends it showing the full face of the bat.
Bowled on a length, Tamim defends the ball off the front foot.
Fires in a flatter delivery down the leg side, Sarkar fails to flick and it goes off his pads to fine leg. They run a leg bye.
Good length ball, defended back to the bowler.
Short of a length and it is punched through covers for a single.
Good length on the pads, Tamim tickles it to square leg for a single.
Full and wide and Tamim plays an expansive drive and misses the ball and it goes through to the keeper.
Again bowled wide outside off and Sarkar opens the face of the bat and guides it to third man for a run.
Just short of the man at third man. Lucky there, Tamim slashes at a ball wide outside off stump and it takes the edge and falls just short of the man at third man. They complete a run.
Good length ball and Tamim comes forward and defends it onto the ground.
Quicker full ball on leg, Sarkar tries to flick but fails to middle it properly.
FOUR! 50 up for Bangladesh! Floated full ball on off, Sarkar kneels and nails his sweep shot through square leg for a boundary.
Leans forward and works it in front of square leg for one.
Helps it off his pads to square leg.
Walks down the track to take it on the full and pushes it down towards long on for one.
Flatter ball on off, Sarkar tries to flick but gets it away off the leading edge. Rolls to short third man.
Powerplay 2 time. Maximum of four fielders allowed outside the ring.
Short in length and it's pulled behind square leg. Slight misfield in the deep but no extra run taken. A single to end the over, 8 from it.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, it's tucked to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Lovely footwork by Sarkar, he dances down to the pitch of the delivery and smashes it over mid on for a boundary.
On middle and leg, flicked behind square leg for one.
Stays back and strokes it firmly to mid off. Straight to the fielder.
Reaches out for a full ball outside off and inside edges it towards mid-wicket for a single. Plenty of inswing on that occasion.
Another bowling change. Jimmy Neesham is introduced into the attack. A wide slip in place.
A front foot defense to end the over. 3 from it, a tidy one by Santner.
Flatter full ball on middle, flicked from the crease to the leg side.
Tickles it with the spin through square leg and gets another single in this over.
Works it off his pads to square leg where Ross Taylor misfields and concedes a single.
Short in length, it's eased in front of square leg for a single.
Gets forward to a full ball and pushes it back to the bowler.
Mitchell Santner has been introduced into the attack. He is fresh from his fifer in the last game and would look to provide the first breakthrough to the Kiwis.
Fullish and on middle and leg, Sarkar plays a good looking on drive but finds the fielder.
Too straight in line, it's worked behind square leg for a single.
This one moves away from the batsman outside off, Tamim tries playing at it but misses.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, Sarkar pulls it down to deep mid-wicket for an easy run.

Bang! A snorter by Bennett. Sends across a shortish ball, around middle, Sarkar tries to lean back and evade but is hit on his hands. Anything short and Sarkar has looked vulnerable. New Zealand should look to work in this area rather than serving him full delivery.
Good length delivery outside off, Sarkar pushes inside the line and edges it. The first slip fielder moves across to his left and stops the ball with a dive.
Short in length and angling away from the batsman, Sarkar guides it to third man and collects a single. Ish Sodhi does the fielding. 9 from the over!
Tries to tempt the batsman with a fuller length delivery outside off, Sarkar watchfully allows it through to the keeper.
Fullish and on middle, Sarkar gets behind the line and blocks it to the leg side.
Bunts a length ball towards wide mid off and pinches a single.
Fullish ball on middle, it's flicked through mid-wicket for three runs. Sarkar is flourishing and getting more confident with every shot.
FOUR! Great shot! Serves a length ball around middle, Sarkar gives the charge and smashes it down the ground for a cracking boundary.
Presses forward to a full ball and defends it back to end the over.
Around middle and off, defended to the off side.
Full and angling away from the batsman, Tamim plays a cracking drive but fails to pierce the gap at covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Goes through with his drive to a full ball and gets it away from the outside edge to third man. One run added to the total.
Good length delivery in the zone around middle and off, Soumya defends it from the back foot.
Angles across a length delivery outside off, Tamim strides forward in defense. 11 from the over, a good one for Bangladesh.
Short delivery this time, Sarkar eases it down to fine leg and collects a single.
Sliding down the leg side, nudged to fine leg for one.
Lands it full and outside off, Sarkar drives it down the ground and Neesham chases it down from mid off. Cuts it off in the deep and saves a run for his team.

FOUR! Lovely timing! Fullish and around off, Sarkar leans forward and across to flick it stylishly through square leg for a boundary. He is settling down now after a nervy beginning. Has struggled against anything pitched short but has been severe on the fuller length deliveries.
Full in length and outside off, Sarkar leans forward and lofts it over covers. Neesham chases it from inside the ring and makes a good stop near the rope. A couple of runs taken.
Full and angling away from the batsman, it's left alone to end the over, a maiden.
Shaping back into the batsman from a length around off, Iqbal meets it with a straight bat and keeps it out in defense.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Good length delivery outside off, tapped down to point where the fielder made a good stop.
Short of a length delivery on middle, Iqbal goes on his toes and defends it down safely to the leg side.
Full in length and angling away from the batsman, Tamim takes his front leg forward to cover the line and shoulders arms.
Straighter in line and angling down further, Sarkar fails to flick and is hit on the pads. No real appeal for an lbw as that appeared to be missing leg.
Good length ball in the line of the stumps, Sarkar defends it from the crease.
FOUR! Glorious by Sarkar! Rance overpitches this time, around off, Soumya gets forward and strokes it through extra cover for a delightful boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Play and a miss! Rance serves it on a length and wide outside off, Sarkar tries to play a booming cover drive but fails to connect. No footwork whatsoever.
Hint of inswing on this occasion, on a length outside off, Sarkar pushes at it and gets an inside edge which goes closely past the off stump.
Again a short delivery, outside off, Tamim shoulders arms to end the over. Testing over by Hamish. Full of pace.
Bangs it short and in the line of the stumps, Tamim defends it down safely from the crease.
Wide! Swinging down the leg side, Tamim tries to flick but misses and Ronchi collects it with a dive to his right.
Alters his length to go full outside off, Sarkar leans forward and drives it through covers for three runs.
Lethal bowling. Targets the rib cage with a perfect short delivery, Sarkar is hurried up, takes his eyes off the ball as he tries to fend it off. Misses and takes a blow on his body. Ouch!
Again it's short and around off, Soumya goes on his toes and defends it to the off side.
Hamish initiates with a well-directed bouncer, good bounce and pace, Sarkar ducks underneath it.
Hamish Bennett to bowl from the other end with the second new ball. Two slips in place for him as well.
Good length ball on off, Tamim gets on the front foot and defends it right under his watchful eyes. Testing first over by Rance.
A little short and around off, Iqbal defends it back.

EDGY FOUR! Not a convincing way to get off the mark. Rance delivers it full and around off, nipping away, Tamim tries to flick on the leg side but it catches the outside edge and races past second slip for a boundary.
Lands it full and just around off, seaming away a touch Iqbal presses forward and defends it to the leg side.
Full in length and angling away from the batsman, it's outside off and Tamim once again defends it by getting forward.
Starts with a very full ball outside off, Tamim leans forward and pushes it out with an angled bat towards the point region.
Time to get underway. Tamim Iqbal and Soumya Sarkar are the Bangladesh openers. It's going to be Seth Rance to speed in first up. He has a coupe of slips in place. Here we go...
Bangladesh - Tamim Iqbal, Soumya Sarkar, Sabbir Rahman, Mushfiqur Rahim(w), Shakib Al Hasan, Mosaddek Hossain, Mahmudullah, Mehedi Hasan, Rubel Hossain, Mashrafe Mortaza(c), Mustafizur Rahman.
New Zealand - Tom Latham(c), Luke Ronchi(w), George Worker, Ross Taylor, Neil Broom, James Neesham, Colin Munro, Mitchell Santner, Ish Sodhi, Seth Rance, Hamish Bennett.

Toss - Mashrafe Mortaza is back after serving his ban for slow over-rates. He comes out for the toss along with Tom Latham. Up goes the coin, New Zealand win it and ELECT TO FIELD! Both teams have one change each. New Zealand bring in Hamish Bennett for Scott Kuggeleijn. For Bangladesh, Mortaza has replaced Taskin Ahmed.

Pitch report - The pitch has an even covering of grass and it will nip around a little bit for the seamers. 270-280 will be a good score here, reckons Owais Shah. Team winning the toss will definitely want to put the opposition in.
Weather report - The sun is out at the moment but the forecast later on is for some rain interruptions.

Hello and welcome everyone for the third match of the tri-series between Bangladesh and New Zealand in Castle Avenue, Dublin. The Asian team shared points in their first game because of the match getting called off due to the rain and would be itching to get out there and gain 4 points from this match. However, they will be up against New Zealand who won their last match and looked quite balanced in spite of missing some key players. Today will be a different challenge though as the Bangla Tigers are a much better unit than the Irishmen. Let's hope for a cracking contest.
